All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Game
Logic of the "Escritura Rapida" game: current level, current word, exact validation of the answer and time available per level.
GameController
Controller of the game view (game-view.fxml).
GameController.HoverHandler
Inner class that handles the mouse hover on the buttons: the button grows a little and the cursor changes to a hand.
GameStage
Window (stage) of the game.
GameTimer
Countdown timer of each level.
ITimerListener
Listener of the events produced by GameTimer.
IWordProvider
Contract for any class that can provide random words or phrases to the game.
Main
Entry point of the "Escritura Rapida" (Fast Writing) game.
TimerAdapter
Adapter class of ITimerListener.
WordBank
Bank of words and phrases used in the game.
